text: ■Next Mission\nMove from Eumano Village Ruins: Central to\nSiccus Plains to start.
You reunited with Zianga and the others in Siccus Plains.\nThey told you that they had seen a bunch of Coenubia\nmonsters. Let's hurry to Umidus Valley to beat them!
You arrived in Umidus Valley, but the Coenubia monsters were\nnowhere to be found. However, you saw some footprints.\nLet's go after them!
While pursuing the Coenubias, you suddenly ended up getting\nsurrounded by them instead! Fight them off!
